claims.text: Google Ads does not document asset quantity limits, specifications, or detailed menu paths, so those steps cannot be described here.

Because the system selects the best asset combination per impression and reports asset performance once enough data accrues, a useful KPI is per-asset (or per-combination) performance within the campaign's conversion and engagement reporting — the causal path is conditional: better-matching asset combinations may lift performance, but no guaranteed uplift is documented.
